theme: Suicide prevention, emotional support, Setembro Amarelo, sensitive and careful tone

responsive.layout: Grid and flex layouts should default to single column on mobile, expanding to multi-column on md and lg screens. Keep visuals from dominating the viewport.
responsive.typography: Use fluid typography or Tailwind responsive text classes (text-2xl md:text-4xl). Inputs should be text-base (16px) minimum to prevent mobile zoom.
responsive.overflow_guard: Ensure max-w-full and overflow-hidden on main wrappers to prevent horizontal scrolling.
responsive.tap_targets: All buttons and links must have a minimum height and width of 44px for easy tapping on mobile.

typography.font_strategy: Pastel & Soft archetype. Use rounded humanist fonts or clean, highly legible sans-serifs that feel friendly, approachable, and non-clinical.
typography.headings: Use fonts like Nunito, Quicksand, or standard 'font-sans' with a soft appearance. Avoid harsh geometric fonts. Use tracking-tight for larger headings.
typography.body: Inter or Figtree, maintaining clarity and legibility. Use leading-relaxed.

visual_enhancers.gradients: Use blur-[100px] on absolute positioned divs to create fluid, soft gradient backgrounds instead of harsh linear gradients.
visual_enhancers.3d_icons: To achieve a 3D stylized look with Lucide React icons, use SVG filters or CSS drop shadows: `filter drop-shadow-md` and bright colors with subtle internal gradients if possible. Alternatively, nest the icon in a container with a subtle Neumorphic shadow.
visual_enhancers.surfaces: Use soft, welcoming surfaces. 'Glassmorphism' with heavy blur (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70`) for sticky headers. 'Neumorphism' (soft UI) can be used for cards on the yellow page to make it feel tactile and gentle.
visual_enhancers.corners: Use large border-radii (`rounded-2xl` or `rounded-3xl`) for cards and buttons to evoke safety and softness.

components.buttons: Large, pill-shaped (`rounded-full`) or highly rounded (`rounded-2xl`). Must have hover states (`-translate-y-1 shadow-lg`) and focus rings.
components.cards: White or off-white with soft ambient shadows (`shadow-sm` to `shadow-md` on hover). No harsh borders. `p-6` or `p-8` minimum padding.
components.tabs: Use Shadcn Tabs for How to Act and Emergency Channels. Style them softly, replacing generic Vercel looks with pill-shaped active states.

chatbot_dante.trigger: Floating action button in bottom right. `fixed bottom-6 right-6 bg-yellow-400 hover:bg-yellow-500 rounded-full p-4 shadow-xl z-50`. Use the 'Ribbon' icon from Lucide React to represent the Setembro Amarelo.
chatbot_dante.modal: Pre-chat form collecting Name, Phone, Age. Chat interface with legal warning and 'Dante está pensando...' loading state.

layouts.portal: Centered, single-column main content with wide spacing. Huge welcoming title, soft fluid background blobs. Two massive navigation buttons side-by-side on desktop, stacked on mobile.
layouts.suicidio: Bento grid or vertical stacked cards. Generous spacing (`gap-8` or `gap-12`). Sections clearly separated with soft horizontal dividers or alternating soft yellow/white backgrounds.
layouts.admin: Standard sidebar or top-nav dashboard layout using Shadcn components (Tables, Cards, Tabs).

motion.transitions: Use `transition-all duration-300 ease-out` for interactive elements. Stagger entrance animations for lists (like psychologists or videos).
motion.chatbot: Smooth fade-in and slide-up for the chat modal. Bouncing dots for 'Dante está pensando...'.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure APCA/WCAG AA contrast. Especially on yellow backgrounds, use dark brown or dark grey text, NOT white.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="btn-prevention"`).

image_urls.description: A welcoming, friendly psychologist sitting on a couch
Psychologist actively listening in a therapy session

instructions_to_main_agent: CREATE a complete mobile-first responsive design. All layouts must gracefully stack on mobile screens.

PORTAL PAGE: Create a white background with two absolute positioned blurred divs (`blur-[100px]`) behind the content using the requested purple (#8A2BE2) and pink (#FF69B4) to create a fluid, welcoming vibe. Add 'Saída Rápida ✕' button at top right (href to google.com). Include 2 big buttons: '💛 Prevenção ao Suicídio e Apoio Emocional' and '📖 Ir para o Site Principal do Livro'.

SUICIDIO PAGE: Use a soft, welcoming yellow gradient (`bg-gradient-to-b from-yellow-50 to-yellow-100`). Honor Setembro Amarelo. Implement all required sections: Hero, About, Playlist, Videos, How to Act (Tabs), Emergency (Tabs), Psychologists, Laws (Filters).

CHATBOT DANTE: Implement a floating button with Lucide's `Ribbon` icon (yellow color). The chat modal needs a pre-chat form (Name, Phone, Age), a chat interface with a legal warning, and a loading state ('Dante está pensando...').
ADMIN PAGE: Create a simple protected layout with Shadcn Tabs for 'Portal' and 'Categorias'.
3D ICONS: Use `lucide-react` icons and apply CSS classes like `drop-shadow-lg text-yellow-600` or wrap them in neumorphic circles to give them a stylized 3D feel.
Ensure dark text is used on the yellow suicide prevention page to maintain high accessibility contrast.
IMPORTANT: All files must be .js or .jsx, NOT .tsx. Provide the guidelines and implement accordingly.
Ensure ALL interactive elements have a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid='btn-quick-exit'`).
DO NOT use a completely transparent background for dropdowns or modals.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Use layered design, thoughtful spacing, and interactive hover states.
Do not use dark colors for gradients. Keep gradients soft and bright.
Use glass-morphism (`backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70`) for floating elements like the chat modal and sticky headers.
Do not center-align body text or entire app containers. Left-align paragraphs.
Apply transitions explicitly (e.g., `transition-transform duration-200`) and NOT `transition-all`.
Use pill-shaped (`rounded-full`) or highly rounded (`rounded-2xl`) buttons to match the soft, welcoming theme.
Never use placeholder URLs. Use the provided image URLs.
